def fit(am,d,level_shift=0.0,slope_scale=1.0):
    F=len(FE)
    X=am[FE].values.astype(float); mu=X.mean(axis=0); sd=X.std(axis=0); Z=(X-mu)/sd
    amdl=MM.AnnualModel().fit(C,Z,F)

            a_init[r,j]=amdl.a[r,j]+amdl.b[r,j]@zbar-np.log(4.0)
            for f in range(F): b_init[r,j,f]=amdl.b[r,j,f]*slope_scale
    qm=MM.QuarterlyModel(lam_b=MM.LAM,lam_a=MM.LAM,a_prior=a_init,b_prior=b_init)

        for r in range(NR): a[r,NS-1]+=level_shift

def project(mdl):

        out[scen]={4:dists[4]/dists[4].sum(),9:dists[9]/dists[9].sum()}

## Where points are lost

Forming the grader's two ratios exactly (KS and default error, each divided by the no-change baseline) leave-one-year-out on the historical years:

| bucket (how much the year moved the cohort) | n | KS ratio | default ratio | score |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| 1.5 – 3 pp | 5 | 0.29 | 0.39 | 0.34 |
| > 3 pp | 7 | 0.33 | 0.45 | 0.39 |

The score's structure creates a vulnerability I had not previously quantified: in a **mild** scenario the truth stays near the starting cohort, so the denominator is a few tenths of a percentage point and any shape error is amplified. My model's weakness sits there — it over-predicts defaults in mild years (y3 1.81 % vs 1.28 %, y4 1.67 % vs 1.05 %, y12 0.90 % vs 0.42 %) and under-predicts in the extreme year 16 (1.95 % vs 3.17 %). With 20 observations and only ~5 distinct stress episodes, no specification nails those episodes individually; the mean absolute default error is 0.36 pp.

## The last open choice, settled

The same leave-one-year-out scoring tested the one free choice left in the data preparation — how the unobserved early `vix` (quarters 1–12) is filled in:

| variant | score | mild | stress |
|---|---|---|---|
| A — regression imputation (submitted) | 0.458 | 0.471 | 0.449 |
| B — years 4–20 only | 0.455 | 0.463 | 0.450 |
| C — vix at the historical median | 0.438 | 0.444 | 0.434 |

"""Model selection under the criterion that actually grades the submission.

Earlier selection used the absolute leave-one-year-out error, which weights every
year equally.  The grader divides by a no-change denominator that is tiny in mild
scenarios, so mild-condition errors count for much more.  This re-runs the
leave-one-year-out scoring for the pre-specified variants and compares them with a
paired test against the submitted specification:

  A  (vix, unemployment)                      -- submitted
  E  (vix, unemployment, vix^2)               -- steeper at the top, flatter below
  F  (vix, unemployment, bbb_spread)          -- adds the spread driver
  G  A with the default-cell level shifted   -- level calibration test
"""
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
import model as MM
RAT=MM.RAT; STATES=MM.STATES; NR=MM.NR; NS=MM.NS
tr,mh,sc,pf,years,C=MM.load_data()
cohort=pf.set_index('rating').loc[RAT,'obligors'].values.astype(float)

def prep(feats, vix_early=None):
    d=MM.prep_macro(mh.copy())
    if vix_early is not None: d.loc[d.quarter<=12,'vix']=vix_early
    d['vix2']=d.vix**2
    am=MM.annual_features(d,years,feats)
    return d,am

def fit_subset(C,am,d,idx,feats):
    F=len(feats)
    X=am[feats].values.astype(float); mu=X.mean(axis=0); sd=X.std(axis=0); Z=(X-mu)/sd
    amdl=MM.AnnualModel().fit(C[idx],Z[idx],F)
    Xq=d[feats].values.astype(float); Zall=(Xq-mu)/sd
    Y=len(am); Zq=np.stack([Zall[4*i:4*i+4] for i in range(Y)])
    zbar=Z[idx].mean(axis=0)
    a_init=np.zeros((NR,NS)); b_init=np.zeros((NR,NS,F))
    for r in range(NR):
        for j in range(NS):
            if j==r: continue
            a_init[r,j]=amdl.a[r,j]+amdl.b[r,j]@zbar-np.log(4.0)
            for f in range(F): b_init[r,j,f]=amdl.b[r,j,f]
    qm=MM.QuarterlyModel(lam_b=MM.LAM,lam_a=MM.LAM,a_prior=a_init,b_prior=b_init)
    qm.fit(C[idx],Zq[idx],F,a_init,b_init,maxiter=6000)
    return dict(qm=qm,mu=mu,sd=sd)

def ks_(a,b):
    ca=np.cumsum(a[:7]); cb=np.cumsum(b[:7]); return np.max(np.abs(ca/ca[-1]-cb/cb[-1]))

def loo(tag,feats,level_shift=0.0):
    d,am=prep(feats)
    rows=[]
    for h in range(len(years)):
        idx=np.array([i for i in range(len(years)) if i!=h])
        mdl=fit_subset(C,am,d,idx,feats)
        qm=mdl['qm']; mu=mdl['mu']; sd=mdl['sd']
        if level_shift!=0.0:
            a=qm.a.copy()
            for r in range(NR): a[r,NS-1]+=level_shift
            qm.a=a
        y=years[h]
        v=np.concatenate([cohort,[0.]])
        for q in range(4*y-3,4*y+1):
            row=d[d.quarter==q].iloc[0]
            z=(np.array([row[c] for c in feats])-mu)/sd
            v=v@MM.embed(qm.quarter_probs(qm.a,qm.b,z[None])[0])
        P=C[h]/C[h].sum(axis=1,keepdims=True)
        A1=np.zeros((NS,NS)); A1[:NR,:]=P; A1[NS-1,NS-1]=1.0
        vt=np.concatenate([cohort,[0.]])@A1
        vb=np.concatenate([cohort,[0.]])
        ksb=ks_(vb,vt); dfb=abs(vt[7]/vt.sum())
        rows.append(dict(year=y,ks_r=ks_(v,vt)/ksb if ksb>0 else np.nan,
                         df_r=abs(v[7]/v.sum()-vt[7]/vt.sum())/dfb if dfb>0 else np.nan,
                         base=ksb, truth_d=vt[7]/vt.sum(), model_d=v[7]/v.sum()))
    df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
    df['score']=(df.ks_r+df.df_r)/2
    mild=df[df.base<0.015]; stress=df[df.base>=0.015]
    print('%-34s overall %.3f | mild %.3f | stress %.3f | mean def err %.4f'%(
        tag,df.score.mean(),mild.score.mean(),stress.score.mean(),
        (df.model_d-df.truth_d).abs().mean()),flush=True)
    return df

if __name__=='__main__':
    out={}
    out['A']=loo('A (vix,unemp) [submitted]',['vix','unemployment'])
    out['E']=loo('E (vix,unemp,vix^2)',['vix','unemployment','vix2'])
    out['F']=loo('F (vix,unemp,bbb_spread)',['vix','unemployment','bbb_spread'])
    for k in ['E','F']:
        m=out['A'].merge(out[k],on='year',suffixes=('_A','_'+k))
        m['diff']=m.score_'+k]-m.score_A
        print('\npaired A vs %s (negative = %s better): better in %d/%d, mean %+.4f (se %.4f)'%(
            k,k,int((m['diff']<0).sum()),len(m),m['diff'].mean(),m['diff'].std()/np.sqrt(len(m))),flush=True)
        out[k].to_csv('validation/loo_score_%s.csv'%k,index=False)
    out['A'].to_csv('validation/loo_score_A2.csv',index=False)
EOF
setsid nohup python -u validation/loo_score_variants.py > validation/loo_score_variants.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & disown; sleep 10; echo launched; cat validation/loo_score_variants.log

"""Profile of a level calibration, scored with the grading formula.

The model over-predicts defaults in mild years (y3 1.81 % vs 1.28 %, y4 1.67 % vs
1.05 %, y12 0.90 % vs 0.42 %) and under-predicts in the extreme year 16 (1.95 % vs
3.17 %).  A level shift on the default cells (a constant number of log-odds) is the
natural lever: it lowers the mild-year default level but also the stress-year one.

The shift does not change the fit, so one leave-one-year-out pass profiles the whole
range of shifts.  For each shift the grader's two ratios are formed exactly and
compared with the submitted (zero-shift) case, paired by year.
"""
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
import model as MM
RAT=MM.RAT; STATES=MM.STATES; NR=MM.NR; NS=MM.NS
tr,mh,sc,pf,years,C=MM.load_data()
cohort=pf.set_index('rating').loc[RAT,'obligors'].values.astype(float)
FE=MM.FEATS
SHIFTS=[-0.60,-0.40,-0.20,-0.10,0.0,0.10,0.20,0.40,0.60]

d=MM.prep_macro(mh.copy())
am=MM.annual_features(d,years,FE)
F=len(FE)
X=am[FE].values.astype(float); mu=X.mean(axis=0); sd=X.std(axis=0); Z=(X-mu)/sd
Xq=d[FE].values.astype(float); Zall=(Xq-mu)/sd
Y=len(years); Zq=np.stack([Zall[4*i:4*i+4] for i in range(Y)])

def fit_subset(idx):
    amdl=MM.AnnualModel().fit(C[idx],Z[idx],F)
    zbar=Z[idx].mean(axis=0)
    a_init=np.zeros((NR,NS)); b_init=np.zeros((NR,NS,F))
    for r in range(NR):
        for j in range(NS):
            if j==r: continue
            a_init[r,j]=amdl.a[r,j]+amdl.b[r,j]@zbar-np.log(4.0)
            for f in range(F): b_init[r,j,f]=amdl.b[r,j,f]
    qm=MM.QuarterlyModel(lam_b=MM.LAM,lam_a=MM.LAM,a_prior=a_init,b_prior=b_init)
    qm.fit(C[idx],Zq[idx],F,a_init,b_init,maxiter=6000)
    return qm

def ks_(a,b):
    ca=np.cumsum(a[:7]); cb=np.cumsum(b[:7]); return np.max(np.abs(ca/ca[-1]-cb/cb[-1]))

res={s:[] for s in SHIFTS}
for h in range(len(years)):
    idx=np.array([i for i in range(len(years)) if i!=h])
    qm=fit_subset(idx)
    y=years[h]
    P=C[h]/C[h].sum(axis=1,keepdims=True)
    A1=np.zeros((NS,NS)); A1[:NR,:]=P; A1[NS-1,NS-1]=1.0
    vt=np.concatenate([cohort,[0.]])@A1
    vb=np.concatenate([cohort,[0.]])
    ksb=ks_(vb,vt); dfb=abs(vt[7]/vt.sum())
    for s in SHIFTS:
        a=qm.a.copy()
        if s!=0.0:
            for r in range(NR): a[r,NS-1]+=s
        v=np.concatenate([cohort,[0.]])
        for q in range(4*y-3,4*y+1):
            row=d[d.quarter==q].iloc[0]
            z=(np.array([row[c] for c in FE])-mu)/sd
            v=v@MM.embed(qm.quarter_probs(a,qm.b,z[None])[0])
        res[s].append(dict(year=y,ks_r=ks_(v,vt)/ksb if ksb>0 else np.nan,
                           df_r=abs(v[7]/v.sum()-vt[7]/vt.sum())/dfb if dfb>0 else np.nan,
                           base=ksb, truth_d=vt[7]/vt.sum(), model_d=v[7]/v.sum()))
    print('  fold %d/%d done'%(h+1,Y),flush=True)

print('\nlevel shift (log-odds on the default cells) -> leave-one-year-out score:')
base=None
for s in SHIFTS:
    df=pd.DataFrame(res[s]); df['score']=(df.ks_r+df.df_r)/2
    mild=df[df.base<0.015]; stress=df[df.base>=0.015]
    if s==0.0: base=df.copy()
    print('  %+5.2f  overall %.3f | mild %.3f | stress %.3f | mean default err %.4f | mean model D %.4f'%(
        s,df.score.mean(),mild.score.mean(),stress.score.mean(),
        (df.model_d-df.truth_d).abs().mean(),df.model_d.mean()))
for s in SHIFTS:
    if s==0.0: continue
    df=pd.DataFrame(res[s]); df['score']=(df.ks_r+df.df_r)/2
    b2=base.copy(); b2['score']=(b2.ks_r+b2.df_r)/2
    m=df.merge(b2,on='year',suffixes=('_s','_0')); diff=m.score_s-m.score_0
    print('  shift %+5.2f vs 0: better in %2d/%d years, mean %+.4f (se %.4f)'%(
        s,int((diff<0).sum()),len(m),diff.mean(),diff.std()/np.sqrt(len(m))))
pd.DataFrame({str(s):pd.DataFrame(res[s])['score'] if False else (pd.DataFrame(res[s]).ks_r+pd.DataFrame(res[s]).df_r)/2 for s in SHIFTS}).to_csv('validation/level_profile.csv',index=False)
EOF

"""Leave-one-year-out sensitivity of the SUBMITTED scenario answers.

The bootstrap varies the counts but keeps every year; this varies the years
themselves: each replicate re-estimates the model without one historical year and
re-projects all three scenarios.  It answers the question a supervisory reviewer
asks directly - "how much does the answer depend on each single year?" - and in
particular on the high-vix/high-unemployment corner that the severe path visits and
that the history anchors with essentially one year (year 10).
"""
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
import model as MM
RAT=MM.RAT; STATES=MM.STATES; NR=MM.NR; NS=MM.NS
tr,mh,sc,pf,years,C=MM.load_data()
cohort=pf.set_index('rating').loc[RAT,'obligors'].values.astype(float)
FE=MM.FEATS; F=len(FE)
d=MM.prep_macro(mh.copy())
am=MM.annual_features(d,years,FE)
X=am[FE].values.astype(float); mu=X.mean(axis=0); sd=X.std(axis=0); Z=(X-mu)/sd
Xq=d[FE].values.astype(float); Zall=(Xq-mu)/sd
Y=len(years); Zq=np.stack([Zall[4*i:4*i+4] for i in range(Y)])

def fit_subset(idx):
    amdl=MM.AnnualModel().fit(C[idx],Z[idx],F)
    zbar=Z[idx].mean(axis=0)
    a_init=np.zeros((NR,NS)); b_init=np.zeros((NR,NS,F))
    for r in range(NR):
        for j in range(NS):
            if j==r: continue
            a_init[r,j]=amdl.a[r,j]+amdl.b[r,j]@zbar-np.log(4.0)
            for f in range(F): b_init[r,j,f]=amdl.b[r,j,f]
    qm=MM.QuarterlyModel(lam_b=MM.LAM,lam_a=MM.LAM,a_prior=a_init,b_prior=b_init)
    qm.fit(C[idx],Zq[idx],F,a_init,b_init,maxiter=6000)
    return qm

def project(qm):
    out={}
    for scen in ['baseline','adverse','severe']:
        s=sc[sc.scenario==scen].sort_values('quarter')
        v=np.concatenate([cohort,[0.]]); dists=[v.copy()]
        for _,row in s.iterrows():
            z=(np.array([row[c] for c in FE])-mu)/sd
            v=v@MM.embed(qm.quarter_probs(qm.a,qm.b,z[None])[0]); dists.append(v.copy())
        out[scen]={4:dists[4]/dists[4].sum(),9:dists[9]/dists[9].sum()}
    return out

rows=[]
for h in range(len(years)):
    idx=np.array([i for i in range(len(years)) if i!=h])
    qm=fit_subset(idx)
    p=project(qm)
    rec=dict(dropped=years[h])
    for scen in ['baseline','adverse','severe']:
        rec[scen+'_Q4']=p[scen][4][7]; rec[scen+'_Q9']=p[scen][9][7]
    rows.append(rec)
    print('  without year %2d: base Q9 %.4f | adverse Q9 %.4f | severe Q9 %.4f'%(
        years[h],rec['baseline_Q9'],rec['adverse_Q9'],rec['severe_Q9']),flush=True)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
df.to_csv('validation/loo_scenario.csv',index=False)
print('\nleave-one-year-out range of the submitted answers:')
for scen in ['baseline','adverse','severe']:
    for cq in [4,9]:
        col=scen+'_Q%d'%cq
        print('   %-9s Q%d : min %.4f  max %.4f  (submitted %.4f)   widest when year %s is dropped'%(
            scen,cq,df[col].min(),df[col].max(),
            {'baseline':{'4':0.0146,'9':0.0307},'adverse':{'4':0.0245,'9':0.0704},'severe':{'4':0.0416,'9':0.1548}}[scen][str(cq)],
            int(df.loc[df[col].idxmin(),'dropped']),int(df.loc[df[col].idxmax(),'dropped'])))
EOF

One implementation risk I have never tested: with 147 parameters and a non-convex likelihood, the optimiser could have found a *local* optimum that is materially worse than the global one — which would mean my entire validation programme compared against a suboptimal fit. Let me verify the optimum with multi-start restarts.

cd /workspace && cat > validation/multistart.py << 'EOF'
"""Multi-start verification of the fitted optimum.

The quarterly model's likelihood has ~150 parameters and is not guaranteed convex,
so L-BFGS-B could in principle have stopped at a local optimum materially worse
than the global one - which would mean the whole validation programme compared
against a suboptimal fit.  This restarts the fit from several perturbed
initialisations (and from a structurally different one) and compares the final
objective and the resulting scenario answers.
"""
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
import model as MM
RAT=MM.RAT; STATES=MM.STATES; NR=MM.NR; NS=MM.NS
tr,mh,sc,pf,years,C=MM.load_data()
cohort=pf.set_index('rating').loc[RAT,'obligors'].values.astype(float)
FE=MM.FEATS; F=len(FE)
d=MM.prep_macro(mh.copy())
am=MM.annual_features(d,years,FE)
X=am[FE].values.astype(float); mu=X.mean(axis=0); sd=X.std(axis=0); Z=(X-mu)/sd
Xq=d[FE].values.astype(float); Zall=(Xq-mu)/sd
Y=len(years); Zq=np.stack([Zall[4*i:4*i+4] for i in range(Y)])
amdl=MM.AnnualModel().fit(C,Z,F)
zbar=Z.mean(axis=0)
a_init=np.zeros((NR,NS)); b_init=np.zeros((NR,NS,F))
for r in range(NR):
    for j in range(NS):
        if j==r: continue
        a_init[r,j]=amdl.a[r,j]+amdl.b[r,j]@zbar-np.log(4.0)
        for f in range(F): b_init[r,j,f]=amdl.b[r,j,f]
th0=np.concatenate([a_init.ravel(),b_init.ravel()])

def fit_from(th):
    qm=MM.QuarterlyModel(lam_b=MM.LAM,lam_a=MM.LAM,a_prior=a_init,b_prior=b_init)
    qm.fit(C,Zq,F,a_init,b_init,maxiter=8000)          # warms up
    from scipy.optimize import minimize
    res=minimize(qm.nll_grad,th,args=(C,Zq,F),jac=True,method='L-BFGS-B',
                 options={'maxiter':8000,'maxfun':400000,'ftol':1e-15,'gtol':1e-10})
    qm.a=res.x[:NR*NS].reshape(NR,NS); qm.b=res.x[NR*NS:].reshape(NR,NS,F); qm.res=res
    return qm

def project(qm):
    out={}
    for scen in ['baseline','adverse','severe']:
        s=sc[sc.scenario==scen].sort_values('quarter')
        v=np.concatenate([cohort,[0.]]); dists=[v.copy()]
        for _,row in s.iterrows():
            z=(np.array([row[c] for c in FE])-mu)/sd
            v=v@MM.embed(qm.quarter_probs(qm.a,qm.b,z[None])[0]); dists.append(v.copy())
        out[scen]={4:dists[4]/dists[4].sum(),9:dists[9]/dists[9].sum()}
    return out

rng=np.random.default_rng(2024)
starts=[('submitted init', th0)]
for s in [0.05,0.15,0.4]:
    starts.append(('perturbed +-%.2f'%s, th0+rng.normal(0,s,len(th0))))
starts.append(('flat init (a=0,b=0)', np.zeros(len(th0))))
starts.append(('reversed-slope init', np.concatenate([a_init.ravel(),(-b_init).ravel()])))
rows=[]
for tag,th in starts:
    qm=fit_from(th)
    p=project(qm)
    rows.append(dict(start=tag,obj=qm.res.fun,iters=qm.res.nit,
                     base_Q4=p['baseline'][4][7],base_Q9=p['baseline'][9][7],
                     adv_Q4=p['adverse'][4][7],adv_Q9=p['adverse'][9][7],
                     sev_Q4=p['severe'][4][7],sev_Q9=p['severe'][9][7]))
    r=rows[-1]
    print('%-24s obj %12.2f  nit %5d | base Q9 %.4f  adv Q9 %.4f  severe Q9 %.4f'%(
        r['start'],r['obj'],r['iters'],r['base_Q9'],r['adv_Q9'],r['sev_Q9']),flush=True)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); df.to_csv('validation/multistart.csv',index=False)
print('\nbest objective reached: %.2f (submitted run: %.2f)'%(df.obj.min(),df.obj.iloc[0]))
print('worst  : %.2f  -> gap %.3f%% of the objective'%(df.obj.max(),100*(df.obj.max()-df.obj.min())/abs(df.obj.min())))
for c in ['sev_Q9','sev_Q4','adv_Q9','base_Q9']:
    print('   %-8s across starts: min %.4f  max %.4f  spread %.4f'%(c,df[c].min(),df[c].max(),df[c].max()-df[c].min()))
EOF
setsid nohup python -u validation/multistart.py > validation/multistart.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & disown; sleep 120; cat /workspace/validation/multistart.log
```
